svg.title: One support, many displays
svg.desc: A class-I membrane complex locates peptide, heavy chain and separate B2M; illustrative allele 1 loss leaves 2 and 3, while a shared functional assembly defect can affect several displays. Class II has a different dependency.

g.text: Compare the breadth of a defect
B2M does not span the membrane
Class II uses a different assembly.
A variant alone does not prove loss.
